title: The Dynamical Status of the Cluster of Galaxies 1E0657-56

evidence.locator: Sect. 3.1: the subcluster's seven galaxies have a mean velocity of 89479 +/- 41 km/s, the main system 88681 +/- 69 km/s. Sect. 3.4 and 4: a radial velocity difference of 616 km/s in the cluster rest frame at a projected distance of 0.7 Mpc; with the X-ray speed of the subcluster, the line connecting the two systems is 5 to 15 degrees from the plane of the sky.
